start.text: Plink, plonk, ping, plink-roll, drop.~ Drop, drop, ping, ping, ping-drop, roll.~ Bzzt, plink, pong, roll-drop-roll-drop.~ Plink, plink, plink, plonk! Plonk! Plink! Drop.~ Drop, roll ... roll ... roll ... Bi-dingdinging!~ Roll, plonk. Roll, plink. Roll? Roll? ROLL!~ Plink, then. Roll, when. Plonk, where. Ping, there.

I'm not a god. I'm not a person. I'm not a mind. I'm not a soul. I'm not human. I'm not nothing. I'm not something.~ Can I play my flute for thee? Plink, ping?~ Oh ... what an ugly little thing.~ Can I drink you? Dink?~ Someone spoke to me within the glossy silver ball. It said, "poor thing."~ Where is death?~ So many moons and planets stolen. And for what?~
